title: A lesson in Chat
viewerNote: Keating’s replies are scripted. The progress rail shows its stage labels with independent review turned off.

chapters.title: Ask Keating
chapters.explanation: Type a concrete learning question in Message Keating. Send it to start the lesson.
chapters.alt: The chat composer contains Teach me how recursion returns.

chapters.title: Follow the reply
chapters.explanation: The progress rail names the stages of the turn. The tutor starts by asking for a prediction.
chapters.alt: Keating's progress rail shows Draft, Review and Reply.

chapters.title: Make a prediction
chapters.explanation: Choose the first answer and send it. Keating responds with a hint and asks you to think again.
chapters.alt: The first choice is selected in the recursion quick check.

chapters.title: Try the question again
chapters.explanation: Choose The first call waits and send your answer. Keating explains where the waiting call resumes.
chapters.alt: The second quick check has The first call waits selected.

chapters.title: Reveal a flashcard
chapters.explanation: Reveal the card, compare your recall with the answer, and rate it Good.
chapters.alt: A revealed flashcard explains where a recursive call waits.

chapters.title: Run the countdown
chapters.explanation: Run tests executes the starter function with the sample inputs. Read both results in the code activity.
chapters.alt: The countdown coding activity with its sample test results.

chapters.title: Read the sources
chapters.explanation: The Sources footer names the references for the reply. You can return to them after the exercise.
chapters.alt: The Sources footer links to MDN’s recursion and call stack entries.

chapters.title: Use a study chip
chapters.explanation: Explain another way adds a follow-up to the composer. Read the suggested wording before you send.
chapters.alt: The composer has the suggested follow-up from Explain another way.

chapters.title: Notice the failed reply
chapters.explanation: The scripted demo tutor interrupts the reply. Your question stays in the conversation.
chapters.alt: The failed response offers a Retry response button.

chapters.title: Retry the reply
chapters.explanation: Retry response sends the same request again. The scripted tutor replies with a folder-tree example.
chapters.alt: A completed tutor reply explains the folder-tree example.
